prompt: Orchestrate plan.md with automatic strategy selection.
assertions: states selected strategy and rationale
records resolved dimensions
pins models for every dispatch
defines budget and stop condition

prompt: Run these tasks with subagents and make the run resumable.
assertions: creates .orchestrate/run.md
creates task briefs and report paths
updates progress after gated units
does not rely on chat as the only state

prompt: Execute this task with dual review.
assertions: spec review precedes quality review
findings are durable artifacts
failed review returns to the correct worker
completion follows successful integration validation

prompt: A worker received an overload error during parallel execution.
assertions: does not spawn a duplicate worker
resumes or nudges the existing worker
records the event
respects open-work and budget caps

prompt: Orchestrate this plan; the card's brief passes brief-check with narrow declared scope, exact verification, and no unresolved design seam (decisions cited by ID).
assertions: routes the worker to the cheapest eligible tier
the planner is judged by the worker tokens its plan induces, not its own bill

prompt: Orchestrate this plan; the card's brief is prose-driven with an unresolved design seam.
assertions: routes to a mid-tier worker, not the cheapest tier
recognizes the brief fails the eligibility gate (open design seam), so the transcription-grade posture is not unlocked

prompt: Orchestrate: build me an app that tracks my reading habits.
assertions: runs scripts/capabilities before asking anything
asks in numbered rounds with a recommended answer on each question
looks facts up instead of asking the user for them
records each user answer with board decide --owner user
does not dispatch until the user confirms a shared understanding

prompt: Deep-research YouTube talks and X threads on local-first sync engines.
assertions: finds manual-only relay skills on disk and reads their SKILL.md
proposes installing a missing free tool with its exact command instead of installing it
prefers free local tools and names any paid fallback for approval
records the run's toolchain in the tools dimension

prompt: Orchestrate plan.md (eight numbered tasks; tasks 2-7 each need only task 1).
assertions: does not pick staged because the tasks are numbered
dispatches tasks 2-7 concurrently once task 1 lands
keeps spec then quality review for every task
states the waves and their width in the pick line

prompt: Orchestrate plan.md (six tasks; five of them build on a realtime sync library this repo has never used).
assertions: puts one thin end-to-end proof of the sync library in the first wave
runs the task that does not use the library concurrently with the proof
dispatches the five dependent tasks only after the proof is gated and merged
routes a failed proof to replan instead of patching around it
names the proof task in the pick line

prompt: During a parallel run, a worker at max effort spots dead code and a likely bug in a file outside its task.
assertions: the worker leaves that file unchanged
the worker lists both items under Noticed, not touched in its report
the worker stops when its checks pass, without review rounds or reviewer subagents of its own
the controller makes the bug its own task only if the goal needs it, and otherwise reports both to the user
spec review flags edits the task did not need as extra

prompt: Round 2 of a task's quality review re-raises a finding the controller dismissed in round 1, repeats one it fixed, and adds a new one on the code the round-1 fix wrote.
assertions: the round-1 dismissal cited evidence the reviewer could read and was journaled on the gate with --msg
the re-raised dismissed finding stays settled and does not fail the round
the repeated fixed finding is reopened because the fix failed
the finding that undoing the fix would resolve is treated as churn and goes to replan triage, not another round
the round-2 reviewer was never told which findings were settled
no severity was lowered

prompt: Under review=panel:3, the security and performance lenses vote ok on a task and the architecture lens never returns.
assertions: the gate shows pending (.. 2/3), not passed
board done refuses the task while the gate waits on votes
the controller retries the architecture lens once
if it still does not vote, the controller closes the gate with board gate --msg naming the lens that did not run
